answer: Proof of Stake ensures Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital in a secure vault, forcing a high financial nadir for any actor attempting to overwhelm the network. By tying consensus weight to the crystal clear distribution of staked assets, the protocol makes identity spoofing prohibitively expensive. An attacker must acquire a majority of the circulating supply, imposing a cost that renders the creation of fake identities economically irrational compared to honest participation.
